about: Birth dates for men in Club Manager's 2026 squads, so their age on 1 August 2026 is exact and not the table's 1 January age moved on (first written in Round 1102, landed and closed in Round 1214). THE RULE: a row is READ only when two different publishers of two different kinds PRINT the date and neither is a wiki. family says which kind a publisher is: club (the club's own site), league, competition, or stats (a statistics site). Two statistics sites are one kind and do not make a row. A row that cannot meet the rule carries thin (a sentence saying why) and scripts/lib/cmAges.mjs leaves it out, so the man keeps the table rule and nothing downstream reads his date. No row is thin today. club is the engine club the man is baked at (it tells namesakes apart). printed is the text as the page showed it on readOn; where a page writes a numeric date the note says which number comes first. table is the man's row in the value table as the lead pulled it (id, year, age). NOTHING SHIPPED READS THIS FILE YET. The bake (scripts/bakeClubManagerRosters.mjs) starts reading it, beside the Round 669 ledger and the window ledger, in the round that re-rates the 2026 files; nothing is copied between the three. src/test/cmValueCurve.test.ts holds every row to the rule. The four men Round 1102 left on one publisher each (Willian José, Saúl Ñíguez, Hulk and Stefan Savic, all on hand written table rows) were given rows by the fix pass of Round 1214, each from two pages opened on 2026-10-10; they are the last four rows.
